t: Versatile Tracer Trueshot chalk marker ideal marking holes up to 100mm deep in hard-to-reach areas. Features a replaceable, 250-shot canister with spray, lock and replace setting for quick, clean marking. Durable ABS body with textured grip, and a tapered barrel to enable use in confined spaces. Delivers clean, accurate, vibrant green chalk marks even in tight spaces. Also features integrated pocket clip and lanyard hole for convenience.
